baseline: Live checkpoint-v27 Momentum-v1 and Whale-v1 source; rejected Maker and Reversion policies absent
measurement: 20 minutes adaptation, then 60 minutes measured across BX, BT, BG; identical starting checkpoints per arm
diagnostics: Execution attribution by aggressor kind, opening/closing/protection and lifecycle phase; controlled entry/quote mechanism ablations are diagnostic only

promotion_gate.completed_pullbacks: at least 50% more, and improvement in a majority of cases
promotion_gate.one_second_realized_volatility: at least 10% higher without spread-driven barcode alternation
promotion_gate.mean_30_minute_range: Report mean and target-window coverage; 0.7-1.5% is a tuning target, not a mandatory range or price constraint.
promotion_gate.funding: no additional money; recovery transfers no more than 10% above baseline; no increased insolvency or broad loss of participation
promotion_gate.safeguards: no new native-suite failures, exact serialized replay, accounting and funded matching audits
promotion_gate.holdout: repeat directional benefits on independent seeds and later saved-world states; reject if improvements only fit development cases

installation: Only after development, holdout, funding endurance and safeguard gates pass. No publication or RBXL save.

screening_gate_revision.when: After development screening, before independent holdout comparisons
screening_gate_revision.reason: The initial no-decrease range rule was stricter than the user's explicit tuning-target constraint. Range is now reported as a tradeoff, not used to force price amplitude. Primary pullback, streak, volatility, funding and safety gates remain unchanged.

frozen_candidate: shorter-thinner (0.45 displayed-size multiplier), plus manual-exit preservation on Maker policy adoption; no starting Maker reduce-only orders in any development checkpoint
